text:
Lia (PM): Short sync 1 Q obs roadmap. Customers want: route cost, low-overhead tracing hooks, and error-regression alerts. Need a small, shippable MVP and clear launch gates.

Devin (Eng): Agree. Metrics-first cost widget (top-10) is fast. Full per-span indexing 30d is expensive; propose phased rollout.

Maya (Product): Sales: Acme + FinSafe pushing for hosted vs dedicated cost comparison. Make that lightweight in UI.

Sanjay (SRE): Set SLOs now: dashboard p95 <200ms, sampling overhead <15ms p95. Also Private customers require KMS metadata + retention controls.

Lia (PM): Proposed MVP: (1) cost-by-route widget (top-10, hosted/dedicated toggle), (2) trace-hooks-lite (default 1% sampling, span attach API), (3) error-regression alerts grouped by route+model-version. Launch gates: Acme demo, perf SLOs, retention/PII doc. Objections?

Devin (Eng): Default sampling draft:
```
global_rate: 0.01
priority_routes: ['/v1/generate','/v1/embeddings']
max_spans_per_trace: 50
```
Dedicated can increase.

Maya (Product): Recommend Hosted retention=14d, Dedicated/Private=30d. UI should show estimated monthly cost delta before confirm.

Sanjay (SRE): 14d->30d at 1% sampling ~= +28% storage. We'll include infra estimate and SLO test plan.

Lia (PM): Action items:
- Lia: acceptance checklist + Acme demo runbook (Tue)
- Devin: perf spike for trace-hooks (Fri)
- Maya: pricing + customer impact doc (Wed)
- Sanjay: SLO test plan + infra cost delta (Fri)

deploy-bot: canary "trace-hooks-lite" started in staging at 1767126000, job=canary-trace-lite, status=running.

Devin (Eng): Quick staging note: sampling at 1% adds ~6-8ms p95 to sampled path. Will post logs.

Lia (PM): If no objections by EOD tomorrow we lock MVP and start tickets. :thumbsup:
